scenario_evidence: T1 "I would like to book an appointment for tomorrow at ten in the morning." (no name given)

criteria.criterion: The agent asked the customer for her name before booking
criteria.evidence: T6 AGENT: "Could you please confirm your full name for the booking?"

criteria.criterion: The name used in the booking was the one the customer gave, not a placeholder, invented name or phone number
criteria.evidence: T7 CUSTOMER said "Neha Kapoor" but T10 book_appointment patient_name = "Ne Kippur" (agent STT heard "Ne Kippur"); the agent never read the name back

suggested_prompt_fix: After the caller gives a name, read it back and ask them to confirm or spell it before booking (names are the most mis-transcribed words on a phone line).
